name: Scarab of Khepri
lore: Khepri was the Egyptian god of the dawn — the sacred scarab beetle who rolled the sun across the sky each morning, renewing creation daily. The Egyptians saw in the humble dung beetle a cosmic truth: that life renews itself endlessly, that every morning the world is born again. This jade scarab hums with that eternal cycle of renewal. Wounds close. Strength returns. Dawn comes again.
unidentified_name: a jade ring shaped like a beetle
